employee, serving in Nagar Palika Parishad, 
Pithoragarh, was sent to Director, however, Director 
turned down the proposal submitted by Nagar Palika 
Parishad, Pithoragarh vide letter dated 31.03.2018.

counter affidavit filed on behalf of respondent nos. 1 
& 2.

order, therefore, writ petition is adjourned for three 
weeks to enable learned counsel for the petitioner to 
move appropriate application for challenging the said 
letter issued by Director.

along with connected matter.

stands disposed of.

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
I.A. No. 8949 of 2024 AND 8950 of 2025
In 
WPSS No. 377 & 376 of 2018
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. D. S. Mehta, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. I.P. Kohli, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State.
3. Mr. Anil Bisht, learned counsel for the 
respondent. 
4. Apparently, on perusal of the Annexure 1 and 3 
of the writ petition, it is clearly evident that the
petitioners are occupying the substantive post, despite 
this, their claim for regularization have been rejected 
on two grounds. Firstly, in the year 1991, there was 
complete ban on employment and secondly, in the year 
2015, policy has been framed by the Government to 
engage only outsourced employee. 
5. Prima facie, this Court is of the view that both the 
grounds are misconceived. 
6. List on 03.11.2025. 
7. In the meantime, learned Standing Counsel may 
get positive instructions in this regard. 
8. Both the urgency applications stand disposed of.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 10.10.2025
SKS
